source_brief.target_audience: Self-directed retail traders, 25–55, comfortable with charts

campaign_summary: Three unique concepts to engage self-directed retail traders with compelling visuals and precise messaging, inspiring confidence in global trading.

concepts.name: Navigate the World
concepts.strategic_idea: Empower traders to explore global markets like seasoned navigators, with our robust platform as their compass.

visual_direction.description: A dynamic scene of a modern compass overlaid on a global map with financial tickers, creating a sense of exploration and direction.

copy_package.headline: Chart Your Course Through Global Markets
copy_package.subheadline: Use our platform to steer your trading journey with precision.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.

midjourney_prompt_pack.prompt_text: A modern compass on a global map with financial tickers, dynamic lighting, no logo, no UI, no readable text, no watermark
midjourney_prompt_pack.notes: Focus on clarity and the allure of navigation.
